issues.description: Method mismatch for Stock.findStockIngredient: the template repository declares findStockIngredient with two parameters (public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive)), while both the problem statement UML and the solution implementation specify a single-parameter method (findStockIngredient(String)). Moreover, the template's other methods (e.g., add and take) call findStockIngredient with a single String argument, which is inconsistent with the template's two-parameter signature and will cause compilation errors and confuse students implementing SealSaloon according to the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Stock.findStockIngredient signature match the problem statement and solution. Either (a) replace the two-parameter method with a single-parameter method: public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) { ... } implementing the intended lookup, or (b) add a one-parameter overload that delegates to the two-parameter variant (e.g., public StockIngredient findStockIngredient(String name) { return findStockIngredient(name, true); }). Also update any internal calls to use the chosen single-parameter API. This will align the starter code with the UML and solution and prevent compilation errors.
